title: Sensors that need recalibration
intro: A vendor's pressure sensors need recalibration on arrival 20 % of the time, independently of each other. A shipment has n = 10 sensors, and X is the number that need recalibration: Binomial(n = 10, p = 0.2). The value of interest is k = 2. Read P(X = 2) = 0.3020, P(X ≤ 2) = 0.6778 and P(X > 2) = 0.3222, and the mean np = 2 sensors.
